extensionDescription.message: Hides empty or URL-like bookmark titles and adds bookmarks quickly via the folder menu.

sectionHideDesc.message: Bookmarks whose title is empty or just repeats the address get an invisible title, so only the favicon is shown. Bookmarks with real names are never changed.

hideUrlLikeLabel.message: Also hide titles that repeat the address

hideUrlLikeDesc.message: Matches the address with or without https://, www. or a trailing slash. Turn off to hide only empty titles.

autoHideNewLabel.message: Check new and renamed bookmarks automatically

autoHideNewDesc.message: A bookmark is checked as soon as you create it or change its title.

scanOnStartupLabel.message: Check all bookmarks when Firefox starts

scanOnStartupDesc.message: Also runs once after the extension is installed or updated.

manualActionsDesc.message: “Hide now” checks all bookmarks with the rules above. “Restore titles” gives icon-only bookmarks a visible title again – the site address, for example github.com/Kustrica.

restoreConfirm.message: Icon-only bookmarks: $COUNT$. Give them a visible title (the site address)? Automatic checks will be turned off, otherwise the titles would be hidden again.

sectionAddDesc.message: Save the current tab from the bookmark context menu – on the bookmarks toolbar, in the Bookmarks menu or in the sidebar.

showAddMenuLabel.message: Show “Add bookmark” in the bookmark context menu

showAddMenuDesc.message: Right-click a folder to save the current tab into it, or right-click a bookmark to save the tab right after it.

addPositionLabel.message: Where to put it in a folder

addPositionEnd.message: At the end of the folder

addPositionStart.message: At the top of the folder

addIconOnlyLabel.message: Save quick-added bookmarks as icon only

addIconOnlyDesc.message: The bookmark is saved without a visible title, so only its favicon is shown – handy for a compact toolbar of site icons.
